title: 🤝 FoGUC AGM 2026
meetingPoint: Grand Union Community Hub, 1 Quay Walk, Wembley, HA0 1DY
description: 🤝 Join us for the Friends of Grand Union Canal Annual General Meeting — an evening to celebrate our progress, share ideas for the year ahead, and connect with fellow canal supporters. Light refreshments will be provided, and everyone is welcome to take part! 🌊
perks: Meet volunteers and local supporters, refreshments available ☕, on-site parking 🅿️ (charges may apply)
bring: Note-taking materials or questions you'd like to raise

title: 🤝 Hayes Canal Festival 🤝
description: 🎉 Celebrate the waterways at the Hayes Canal Festival! Enjoy community stalls, family activities, local groups, and canal-themed fun along the Grand Union. We'll have our stall promoting the canalside and the need to look after it, with a bunch of fun activities including a competition. A relaxed and friendly day out for all ages by the waterside. 🌊
perks: Family-friendly activities, community stalls, info from local groups, refreshments available ☕
bring: Comfortable shoes, water, and enthusiasm for canal-side fun!

title: 🎉 Parkside Yards Summer Fun Day 🎉
meetingPoint: Parkside Yards at The Green Quarter, UB1 1GH
description: A popular event that promises a great day out for all the family! Come and check out our stall promoting the canalside and the need to look after it, with fun games and competitions. Entry is free, and guests will enjoy activities including fairground stalls, face painting and arts & crafts. A BMX bike show will provide the entertainment, along with music throughout the day, while refreshments will include everything from candyfloss through to a (make-your-own) smoothie bike! Parkside Markets will also be trading on the day, offering a range of lifestyle products from some fantastic independent businesses.
perks: Family-friendly activities, community stalls, info from local groups, refreshments available ☕

title: 🚮 Joint Litter Pick with Who Is Hussain 🚮
description: 🎉 Join the Friends of Grand Union Canal and volunteers from Who Is Hussain London to clear away litter and smarten up the canalside in Brent! Families, first-timers, and canal enthusiasts are all welcome. All equipment is provided (children must be accompanied at all times) 🌊
perks: Enjoy the fresh air, show people you care, meet fellow volunteers 🌞
bring: Gloves, strong footwear, water to drink, weather-appropriate clothing 🧤👢

title: Join us at the Greenford Quay Canal Festival!
meetingPoint: Greenford Quay, Tillermans Court, Grenan Square, Greenford UB6 0FP
description: 🦡 Come and meet us at the Greenford Quay Canal Festival 2026! We'll be promoting the canalside and the importance of looking after it, with a bunch of fun activities for all the family. And there's masses of other activities, including paddleboarding taster sessions, mini Ferris wheel, live music and plenty of yummy eats - click the link and grab a free ticket!🍃
perks: Meet new friends, enjoy the fresh air, fun activities for all, amazing food 🌞

title: 🏰 September Old Crown Canal Cleanup!
meetingPoint: The Old Crown, Station Road, Hayes, UB3 4BG
description: 🏰 Clear and Care! Join the Hillingdon Litter Pickers at the Old Crown for a friendly community canal cleanup in Hayes. Families, first-timers, and canal enthusiasts are all welcome! 🍃 🍻 All gear provided.
perks: Enjoy the fresh air, feel good about making a difference, meet other volunteers, maybe have a drink after!
bring: Gloves, strong footwear, weather-appropriate clothing, water and sun protection 🧤👢🌞

title: Alperton Cleanup with the CRT Towpath Team
description: Join us and Canal and River Trust volunteers on Sunday 27th September between 10:00-13:30 at Alperton Sainsbury's HA0 1LG for a satisfying days volunteering on the beautiful Grand Union Canal. We'll be tackling this litter hot spot to give the area a real lift. All tools and equipment will be provided, together with expert and friendly support. All under 16's need to be accompanied by an adult. This is a great way to meet other local volunteers and spend a few hours outdoors improving your local waterway environment. No experience is required, you just need to be willing to get stuck in and get dirty.
perks: Enjoy the fresh air, feel good about making a difference, meet other volunteers
